name: lead_qualification
description: Structured qualification of a single inbound lead. Every field is required so downstream CRM routing never receives a partially-shaped object.

score.description: Overall lead quality 0-100. Combines intent strength, budget, timeline and fit.

intent.description: hot = ready to buy soon with budget; warm = interested, evaluating; cold = low intent / off-topic / info-only.

is_spam.description: True for bots, promotional blasts, scams, or nonsense. Spam is dropped, never routed to sales.

budget_signal.description: stated = a number/range given; implied = 'budget approved/flexible' without a number; none = no budget cue.

timeline_signal.description: urgent = now/this week/ASAP/by end of month; this_quarter = next month/next quarter; none = no timeline cue.

need_summary.description: One-sentence plain-language summary of what the lead actually wants.

pipeline_stage.description: Target GoHighLevel pipeline stage derived from intent + spam.

recommended_action.description: alert-sales-now for hot; auto-nurture for warm; no-action for cold/spam.

confidence.description: Model confidence in this classification. Below 0.6 the workflow flags for human review instead of auto-routing.
